articles.title: Lift Out of Service at Derker Tram Stop
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers travelling towards and away from Manchester.
articles.content_html:
The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service. The disruption began on Monday, 10 August, at 5:59pm and will continue until further notice.

Passengers travelling towards Manchester can access the platform via a ramp from Cromford Street. Those travelling away from Manchester can also use a ramp from Cromford Street and must cross the tracks to reach the Rochdale bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester (TfGM) has apologised for any inconvenience caused by this disruption.

For more information, visit the Bee Network live travel alerts page.
